video.title: Text Field, First Responder & Keyboard Notification | Day 106
video.description:
Learn to explain how the keyboard, text fields and your layout work together: Text Field, First Responder & Keyboard Notification, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Text Field - A single-line box where the user types text.
First Responder - The object that receives the keyboard input right now.
Keyboard Notification - A system message that tells your app when the keyboard shows, hides or changes size.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Text Field, First Responder & Keyboard Notification | Day 106
landscape.description:
Explain Text Field, First Responder & Keyboard Notification in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
텍스트 필드, 퍼스트 리스폰더, 키보드 노티피케이션 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Text Field - A single-line box where the user types text.
한국어: 텍스트 필드: 사용자가 한 줄 텍스트를 입력하는 입력창

First Responder - The object that receives the keyboard input right now.
한국어: 퍼스트 리스폰더: 지금 키보드 입력을 받고 있는 객체

Keyboard Notification - A system message that tells your app when the keyboard shows, hides or changes size.
한국어: 키보드 노티피케이션: 키보드가 나타나거나 사라지거나 크기가 바뀔 때 앱에 알려 주는 시스템 메시지

In this video, Mina and Jake move a form up when the keyboard covers it, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: The keyboard covers your form. Can you explain how to fix it in English?

dialogue.title: The keyboard covers the form

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the keyboard covers my Text Field at the bottom.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Listen for the Keyboard Notification. It tells you the keyboard height.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I do that with `keyboardWillShowNotification`, like in the code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. When it fires, move the form up.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And how does the keyboard appear in the first place?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The Text Field becomes the First Responder.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. And when you tap Done, resign the First Responder.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then the keyboard hides, and I get a second Keyboard Notification.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Move the form back down in that one.

dialogue.code:
field.becomeFirstResponder()
let show = UIResponder
    .keyboardWillShowNotification
NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
    forName: show, object: nil,
    queue: .main) { _ in }
